coefficient_status: provisional adopted coefficients for next simulation; physical validation pending
axis_model: independent single-axis 1-DOF for IN and OUT; no cross-axis coupling

sensor_model_assumptions.note: Noise and delay values other than encoder bit/resolution are provisional assumptions, not measured characteristics.

local_linearization_scope: static equilibrium, rate=0; c_quad slope is zero; smoothed Coulomb friction local slope is tau/epsilon
noise_tone_method: apply pure sinusoidal measurement-angle error to nonlinear 3-state RTS; 30 s record, fit last 25 s
finite_amplitude_damping_method: energy-equivalent viscous damping from one sinusoidal rate cycle, evaluated at inertial frequency scale; descriptive approximation
